title: novou/square-maximality-palomar
abstract: A Lean 4 formalization of square maximality for spanning trees of induced subgraphs of the square lattice. For every positive integer n and every finite set S of n^2 points in Z^2, the induced lattice graph on S has at most as many spanning trees as the n by n square, with equality exactly when S is a translate of that square. The development also proves the corresponding strict and equality statements for arbitrary spanning subgraphs, together with the finite Matrix--Tree theorem and the proof chain used by the paper.
